items.title: Costco (COST) Pushes Further Into GLP 1 Weight Loss Prescriptions
items.summary: Costco Wholesale is accelerating its entry into the weight loss drug market through GLP-1 prescriptions and related healthcare services. The company is moving alongside Walmart and Amazon as retailers compete to attract customers seeking access to these treatments. Industry cutbacks on employer drug coverage are pushing more patients toward direct-to-consumer fulfillment programs. items.title: Walmart dips after Oppenheimer downgrades shares on difficult short-term setup
items.summary: Investing.com -- Oppenheimer on Tuesday downgraded Walmart shares to Perform from Outperform on Monday and removed its $140 price target, citing a less compelling near-term case for the stock ahead of the retailer’s August 20 earnings report.

items.title: Walmart (WMT) Launches Florida Drone Delivery And GLP 1 Weight Loss Prescriptions
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT) is rolling out drone delivery in parts of Florida through a partnership with Alphabet owned Wing. The company is also expanding into GLP-1 weight loss drug prescriptions, paired with nutrition coaching and AI based support services. Both moves come as competition with other large retailers intensifies around delivery speed and direct to consumer healthcare offerings.
